# FRELUX SMART CALC

> FRELUX is a construction material takeoff and cost estimation engine. It turns
> measured dimensions into material quantities, prices them in the local market,
> and shows the arithmetic behind every figure. Quantities are deterministic: an
> AI layer may extract measurements, but it never calculates. Where a price, a tax
> rate or a design value is not known, the page reports the gap instead of
> assuming one.

Public origin: https://freluxtools.com
Languages: English
Free to use: yes, no sign-up required for calculations.

## Answer pages (prerendered, FAQPage structured data)

- https://freluxtools.com/faq/ - every construction question FRELUX answers, by trade (310 questions across 62 tools)
- https://freluxtools.com/faq/paint-calculator/ - how much paint and primer a room needs
- https://freluxtools.com/faq/tile-calculator/ - tiles, adhesive and grout quantities
- https://freluxtools.com/faq/screeding-calculator/ - screeding material per square metre
- https://freluxtools.com/faq/pop-ceiling-calculator/ - POP ceiling cost and materials
- https://freluxtools.com/faq/foundation/ - foundation concrete, footing and blockwork
- https://freluxtools.com/faq/reinforcement/ - rebar length and weight
- https://freluxtools.com/faq/blueprint-takeoff/ - quantities read from a plan
- https://freluxtools.com/faq/boq-generator/ - bill of quantities from measured work
- https://freluxtools.com/faq/window-blinds/ - how window blinds are priced per window and per square metre

## Core tools

- https://freluxtools.com/calculators/ - the full tool list
- https://freluxtools.com/construction-tools - construction calculators by discipline
- https://freluxtools.com/window-blind-calculator - window blind cost per window and per job from measured openings, with waste, panel joins, minimum charge and fitting
- https://freluxtools.com/tools/interiors - interior decor tools, including window blinds
- https://freluxtools.com/material-prices - recorded material prices with dates and markets
- https://freluxtools.com/prices - market price intelligence
- https://freluxtools.com/unit-converter - metric and imperial conversion for site measurements
- https://freluxtools.com/building-types/ - building types with room schedules, floor and wall areas

## Reference

- https://freluxtools.com/learn - guides and building knowledge
- https://freluxtools.com/glossary - construction and material terms
- https://freluxtools.com/about - what FRELUX is and who builds it
- https://freluxtools.com/ai-disclaimer - what the AI features do and do not do
- https://freluxtools.com/disclaimer - estimates are not professional or engineering advice

## Crawling

- https://freluxtools.com/robots.txt - no crawl restrictions for search or AI crawlers
- https://freluxtools.com/sitemap.xml - full URL inventory
- https://freluxtools.com/ads.txt - authorized digital sellers inventory declaration (IAB Tech Lab standard)
- [Skyscraper Structure and Foundation Calculator](https://freluxtools.com/tall-building-structure/): Deterministic high rise screening for lateral systems, ASCE 7-22 wind and seismic demand, drift, raft and piled foundations, quantities and programme.
- [Mathematical Plan Elevation](https://freluxtools.com/mathematical-plan-elevation/): Elevation and preliminary quantities from entered dimensions, with roof pitch trigonometry and an illustrative 5D schedule.
